column1: # scenario: trimmed level flight (engine running) across view at 25.0 m/s (D5: six-axis trim
# aircraft_input_hash_convention: sha256 of exact aircraft input file bytes
# ground_effect_model: image-induced-factor-v1 (aero.ground_effect: strip induced angle/drag and tail downwash from the field terrain height
# continuous_layout: wheel rim speeds in m/s
# ground: retractable tricycle; downlock point contacts; rudder nose steering; main wheel brakes; weight-on-wheels retraction interlock
# loads: Fx..Mz: body-axis loads excluding gravity; tick 0 evaluates reset state/aux; tick k>0 evaluates state k-1 with aux k (after pre_step)
# state_timing: state and aux at tick k; aux advances before RK4 and is held through its stages; cmd_* drives that step (reset commands at tick 0)
# wheel_profile_hash_convention: profile_sha256 is canonical JSON for the selected aircraft profile; input_sha256 is SHA-256 of exact wheel_profiles.json bytes
# wake_state_unit: m/s (equal-area mean of section Vp*CL)
